استنبئوا (form X)
# اُسْتُنْبِئُوا (ustunbiʔū) /us.tun.bi.ʔuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# اِسْتَنْبِئُوا (istanbiʔū) /is.tan.bi.ʔuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
